Old rickety place. But don't buy the looks. Inside they cook next level food.
Both chicken and mutton biryani available. Timing 10 to 3.30 pm and 6 to 11 pm. …
Not kids friendly as bar is attached. Plz try mutton keema fry or pepper dry with ragiball, amazing taste. Don't forget to ask for a small glass of rasam... Zing zing taste
